# design_poc (look mockups)

Static mockups of possible looks for a Reflex version of
`experimental/textual-kernel`, all in Everforest (dark, medium). No kernel, no real
editor: content is hardcoded (`design_poc/sample.py`, `design_poc/looks/agent_common.py`). Add a new
look as a page function under `design_poc/looks/` and register it in `design_poc/design_poc.py`.
The usable app built from the `/split` look is `services/ui`.

```sh
cd experimental/design_poc
uv run reflex run
# -> http://localhost:3001
```

Looks (switcher at the top of every page):

- Notebook-shaped: `/tui`, `/hybrid`, `/zed`, `/widgets` (hybrid + interactive data viewer).
- AI-first, where an agent's tool output becomes an interactive widget and a named object
  (`r1`) you can script in Python: `/thread`, `/split`, `/shelf`, `/canvas`. These show real
  Little Mac frame data from `ds.data.SmashDb`; the chat text is mockup copy.
